text: "WOMEN could be here" he thought, "I've never been in this colony before. There could be WOMEN anywhere." The cool wind felt good on his bare chest. "I HATE WOMEN" he thought. Rhythm Emotion reverberated his entire nataku, making it pulsate even as the 900 yuan paint fumes circulated though his powerful thick veins and washed away his (merited) fear of women after dark. "With a Gundam you can go anywhere you want" he said to himself, out loud.
